eam.asset_register.label: asset_id
eam.asset_register.description: Canonical asset key (BUS-204, TRAM-117, LIFT-AUB-03, TRK-T1-S07). Stable across fleet-number reissue: a reissued fleet number gets a new asset_id.

eam.asset_register.label: source_alias
eam.asset_register.description: The EAM's own equipment number. Two networks reuse fleet numbers; the alias is only unique together with network_code.

eam.asset_register.label: network_code
eam.asset_register.description: Network the asset belongs to. VALMO for every row in this extract.

eam.asset_register.label: asset_class
eam.asset_register.description: Bus, Tram, Bus component, Tram component, Track, Signalling, Traction power, Charging, Depot equipment, Depot facility, Stations, Systems.

eam.asset_register.label: model
eam.asset_register.description: Manufacturer model (Arvéa Citybus 12 D, Transalp TV-100 …).

eam.asset_register.label: vin_or_serial
eam.asset_register.description: VIN for road vehicles, manufacturer serial for equipment. Null for linear and civil assets.

eam.asset_register.label: commissioned_date
eam.asset_register.description: Date the asset entered service. For tram TV-100 this is the 2008–09 acceptance date.

eam.asset_register.label: status
eam.asset_register.description: In service, Restricted, Withdrawn, Awaiting disposal.

eam.asset_register.label: site_id
eam.asset_register.description: Home depot or location (DEP-AUB, DEP-SRO, DEP-CMT, or a line segment for linear assets).

eam.asset_register.label: owner_party
eam.asset_register.description: Legal owner as the EAM records it. Always 'Valmont Métropole' for biens de retour — ownership is not responsibility; see contract.responsibility_assignment.

eam.asset_register.label: criticality
eam.asset_register.description: Engineering criticality A/B/C. A = a failure removes service or creates a safety restriction.

eam.asset_register.label: valid_from
eam.asset_register.description: Start of this version of the asset record.

eam.asset_register.label: valid_to
eam.asset_register.description: End of this version; null for the current row.

eam.component_installation.label: component_serial
eam.component_installation.description: Serial of the installed component (traction battery pack, engine, bogie, pantograph).

eam.component_installation.label: component_type
eam.component_installation.description: Battery pack, Engine, Gearbox, Bogie, Pantograph, Door drive, HVAC unit.

eam.component_installation.label: parent_asset_id
eam.component_installation.description: The vehicle the component sits in during this interval. Joins asset_register.asset_id.

eam.component_installation.label: position
eam.component_installation.description: Position on the parent (roof pack 1, bogie B2 …).

eam.component_installation.label: usage_at_transfer_km
eam.component_installation.description: Accumulated component km at installation, carried across vehicles.

eam.component_installation.label: project_code
eam.component_installation.description: Capital project the installation belongs to, where it was a campaign (P-VM-031 for the battery campaign). Null for routine swaps.

eam.work_order.label: status
eam.work_order.description: Open, In progress, Awaiting parts, Closed, Cancelled. An open work order does NOT mean the vehicle is unavailable — use availability_interval.

eam.work_order.label: failure_id
eam.work_order.description: The failure event the work order answers, for corrective work.

eam.work_order.label: project_code
eam.work_order.description: Capital project code where the work is a project task; null for maintenance.

eam.work_order.label: actual_finish
eam.work_order.description: Close-out timestamp. Null while open; 312 closed orders lack it (known close-out gap).

eam.work_order.label: material_cost_eur
eam.work_order.description: Parts issued against the order, EUR HT, at stores average cost.

eam.work_order.label: technician_note
eam.work_order.description: Free-text narrative from the technician. Can carry names — masked for Data Analyst.

eam.failure_event.label: failed_at
eam.failure_event.description: Time of failure as reported by the driver or the system.

eam.failure_event.label: symptom_code
eam.failure_event.description: Reported symptom (loss of oil pressure, BMS fault, door fault …).

eam.failure_event.label: failure_mode
eam.failure_event.description: Confirmed failure mode, set after diagnosis. Null = not yet confirmed — a symptom is not a cause.

eam.failure_event.label: downtime_start
eam.failure_event.description: Start of the unavailability this failure caused.

eam.failure_event.label: downtime_end
eam.failure_event.description: End of that unavailability; null if still unavailable or not recorded.

eam.condition_assessment.label: method
eam.condition_assessment.description: Visual, NDT ultrasonic, Rail profile measurement, Thermography, Statutory (lifting equipment).

eam.condition_assessment.label: score
eam.condition_assessment.description: Condition score in the scale named by score_scale. Scales differ by method — never average across scales.

eam.condition_assessment.label: next_inspection_due
eam.condition_assessment.description: Next due date for the assessed asset.

eam.usage_monthly.label: meter_reset_flag
eam.usage_monthly.description: True when the meter was reset or rolled over this month — exclude from exposure until reconciled.

eam.availability_interval.label: reason
eam.availability_interval.description: Corrective, Preventive, Campaign, Awaiting parts, Accident, Not released by engineering.

eam.availability_interval.label: engineering_release
eam.availability_interval.description: Released by engineering for passenger duty.

eam.availability_interval.label: depot_id
eam.availability_interval.description: Depot holding the vehicle during the interval.

eam.maintenance_plan_due.label: asset_id
eam.maintenance_plan_due.description: Asset the task is due on.

eam.maintenance_plan_due.label: due_km
eam.maintenance_plan_due.description: Due point in km, for distance-based tasks.

eam.maintenance_plan_due.label: overdue_km
eam.maintenance_plan_due.description: How far past due_km the asset ran before the task was done (or to date).

telemetry.battery_soh_daily.label: soh_pct
telemetry.battery_soh_daily.description: State of health, % of nominal capacity, from the BMS estimator (algorithm v3.2).

telemetry.battery_soh_daily.label: max_cell_temp_spread_c
telemetry.battery_soh_daily.description: Max cell-module temperature spread in the day, °C.

fin.budget_line.label: cost_category
fin.budget_line.description: Works, Equipment, Studies, Internal labour, Contingency.

fin.budget_line.label: budget_version
fin.budget_line.description: Original baseline, Revised 1, Revised 2 … — each approved version is kept.

fin.budget_line.label: funding_source
fin.budget_line.description: PPI (authority), GER (Keolis, inside contract price), GRANT (state via authority).

fin.budget_line.label: approver_role
fin.budget_line.description: Role that approved the version (Comité d'investissement Keolis Valmont, Bureau métropolitain).

fin.cost_transaction.label: posting_date
fin.cost_transaction.description: Date the line was posted — a March service can post in April.

fin.cost_transaction.label: amount_eur
fin.cost_transaction.description: Posted amount, EUR HT. Negative for reversals.

fin.cost_transaction.label: project_code
fin.cost_transaction.description: Capital project code. Null on 412 lines worth €1.31M — kept visible as UNALLOCATED, never dropped.

fin.cost_transaction.label: wo_id
fin.cost_transaction.description: EAM work order the cost belongs to, where the line came from stores.

fin.cost_transaction.label: reversal_of
fin.cost_transaction.description: The ledger line this one reverses (accrual reversal on invoice arrival).

fin.accrual_line.label: po_line
fin.accrual_line.description: PO line the accrual is raised against.

fin.accrual_line.label: amount_eur
fin.accrual_line.description: Accrued, not yet invoiced, EUR HT.

fin.accrual_line.label: matched_invoice
fin.accrual_line.description: Invoice that reversed this accrual; null = still valid.

fin.forecast_snapshot.label: snapshot_date
fin.forecast_snapshot.description: Forecast date. Monthly, plus ad-hoc re-forecasts.

fin.forecast_snapshot.label: actual_through
fin.forecast_snapshot.description: Actuals included up to this date.

fin.forecast_snapshot.label: ctc_committed_eur
fin.forecast_snapshot.description: Remaining committed work — not the full PO value again.

fin.forecast_snapshot.label: contingency_eur
fin.forecast_snapshot.description: Separately held contingency (not inside the CTC figures).

fin.funding_claim.label: project_code
fin.funding_claim.description: Project or need code the claim lines against.

fin.funding_claim.label: funding_agreement
fin.funding_claim.description: PPI convention or grant agreement reference.

fin.funding_claim.label: status
fin.funding_claim.description: Potential, Submitted, Accepted, Disputed, Paid — five separate states, never collapsed.

fin.funding_claim.label: submitted_on
fin.funding_claim.description: Submission date; null for potential lines.

proc.po_line.label: project_code
proc.po_line.description: Project the line is charged to.

proc.po_line.label: required_date
proc.po_line.description: Date the project needs the item.

proc.po_line.label: promised_date
proc.po_line.description: Supplier's latest promised date as recorded in the ERP — can lag correspondence.

proc.supplier.label: category
proc.supplier.description: Rolling stock, Equipment, Works, Systems, Services.

proc.supplier.label: contact_email
proc.supplier.description: Account manager email — PII, masked for Data Analyst.

proc.part_inventory.label: reserved
proc.part_inventory.description: Reserved — including emergency-maintenance reserve, which a project cannot draw.

proc.supplier_commitment_event.label: po_line
proc.supplier_commitment_event.description: PO line the statement is about.

proc.supplier_commitment_event.label: source
proc.supplier_commitment_event.description: ERP update, Supplier portal, Email (runtime — confirmed only when procurement records it).

proc.supplier_commitment_event.label: confirmed
proc.supplier_commitment_event.description: Recorded by procurement. An email promise stays unconfirmed until then.

ppm.project.label: PROJECT CODE
ppm.project.description: Capital project key (P-VM-021). Needs use N-VM-nnn and live in intervention_need.

ppm.project.label: CATEGORY
ppm.project.description: Fleet — bus, Fleet — tram, Depot & workshop, Track & civil, Signalling & systems, Power & charging, Stations & passenger info.

ppm.project.label: STAGE
ppm.project.description: Need, Option study, Approved, In delivery, Commissioning, Accepted.

ppm.project.label: CONTRACT ID
ppm.project.description: Operating contract the project sits under (DSP-VM-2021).

ppm.project.label: MAITRE OUVRAGE
ppm.project.description: Who owns the delivery decision (Valmont Métropole, or Keolis Valmont as delegated).

ppm.project.label: PURPOSE SGR PCT
ppm.project.description: Share of scope that is renewal (state of good repair). Business purpose, not accounting treatment.

ppm.project.label: BASELINE VERSION
ppm.project.description: Approved schedule baseline in force (BL1, BL2).

ppm.work_package.label: ALLOCATION BASIS
ppm.work_package.description: How costs are allocated to it (direct, % of PO line, unallocated).

ppm.project_asset_link.label: ASSET ID
ppm.project_asset_link.description: Asset. A link says the project touches the asset — it does not attribute the asset's maintenance cost to the project.

ppm.project_asset_link.label: ROLE
ppm.project_asset_link.description: Replaces, Renews, Withdraws for works, Depends on, Affects service of.

ppm.project_asset_link.label: WITHDRAWAL FROM
ppm.project_asset_link.description: Start of any withdrawal from service the project causes.

ppm.schedule_task.label: CURRENT FINISH
ppm.schedule_task.description: Current forecast finish, as the project office last published it.

ppm.schedule_task.label: PREDECESSOR
ppm.schedule_task.description: Predecessor task or external dependency (PO line, access window).

ppm.risk_change_register.label: ITEM TYPE
ppm.risk_change_register.description: Risk (possible), Issue (happened), Change request (asks for authorisation).

ppm.risk_change_register.label: COST IMPACT EUR
ppm.risk_change_register.description: Requested or estimated cost impact, EUR HT.

ppm.approval_decision.label: OBJECT REF
ppm.approval_decision.description: What was approved (project, budget version, change, access request).

ppm.approval_decision.label: DECISION
ppm.approval_decision.description: Approved, Approved with conditions, Deferred, Rejected.

ppm.approval_decision.label: CONDITIONS
ppm.approval_decision.description: Conditions attached — an approval with open conditions is not unconditional.

ppm.intervention_need.label: NEED ID
ppm.intervention_need.description: Need key (N-VM-044). Exists before any project does — this is where the unfunded backlog lives.

ppm.intervention_need.label: TRIGGER
ppm.intervention_need.description: Defect, Ageing, Obsolescence, Contract renewal date, Regulatory inspection, Authority plan.

ppm.intervention_need.label: STATUS
ppm.intervention_need.description: Unfunded, Option study, Deferred, Combined, Approved, Under review.

ppm.intervention_need.label: MANDATORY BASIS
ppm.intervention_need.description: Why it cannot be deferred, where it cannot.

ppm.acceptance_item.label: RESTRICTION
ppm.acceptance_item.description: Operating restriction attached to the acceptance.

ops.access_window.label: STATUS
ops.access_window.description: Requested, Provisional, Approved, Refused. Only Approved is access.

ops.access_window.label: SUBSTITUTION BUSES
ops.access_window.description: Replacement buses planned for the closure.

contract.org_relationship.label: RELATIONSHIP
contract.org_relationship.description: Subsidiary of, Operates for, Maintains for, Overhauls for.

contract.contract_version.label: EFFECTIVE DATE
contract.contract_version.description: When the version applies in the business.

contract.contract_version.label: RECEIVED DATE
contract.contract_version.description: When Keolis received the executed version — knowledge time, kept apart from effective time.

contract.contract_version.label: DOCUMENT REF
contract.contract_version.description: Controlled document in the contract folder.

contract.responsibility_assignment.label: ASSET SCOPE
contract.responsibility_assignment.description: Asset or class the assignment covers (BUS-201..BUS-208).

contract.responsibility_assignment.label: ROLE
contract.responsibility_assignment.description: Owner, Operator, Maintainer, Replacement obligor, Payer (heavy component after replacement date), Approver, Handback recipient.

contract.responsibility_assignment.label: CONDITIONS
contract.responsibility_assignment.description: Conditions (notice within 30 days, cap €35,000, exclusion for operator maintenance default).
